module_summary: UART transmitter: a 4-state FSM loads a byte into a shift register and serializes start, 8 data and stop bits paced by a baud counter.

anchors.name: state_q
anchors.why: IDLE/START/DATA/STOP controller; drives tx_o mux, ready/busy and shift loading.

anchors.name: tx_valid
anchors.why: Request input that starts a transmission and loads shift register in IDLE.

anchors.name: tx_ready
anchors.why: Ready output, high when FSM is IDLE and can accept a byte.

anchors.name: tx_data
anchors.why: Parallel byte payload loaded into the shift register.

anchors.name: tx_o
anchors.why: Serial line output: start bit, shift_q LSB, or idle/stop high.

anchors.name: shift_q
anchors.why: Shift register holding the byte, shifted right each data-bit baud tick.

anchors.name: baud_cnt_q
anchors.why: Baud divider counter, cleared in IDLE or at baud_tick.

anchors.name: bit_idx_q
anchors.why: Counts transmitted data bits; at 7 moves FSM to STOP.

anchors.name: baud_tick
anchors.why: Bit-period clock-enable from baud counter; advances FSM, shift and bit index.

anchors.name: busy_o
anchors.why: Level busy indication decoded from FSM not IDLE.

groups.name: tx_controller
groups.description: Transmit FSM sequencing start, data and stop bits; produces busy status.

groups.name: baud_and_bit_counters
groups.description: Baud-rate divider producing bit tick and data bit index counter.

groups.name: tx_serializer
groups.description: Shift register and output mux producing the serial line.

groups.name: tx_input_handshake
groups.description: Valid/ready byte input accepted when FSM is idle.
